name: Shuang Hei - Shuangri Pian
source:
The story follows your life in a new city after parting ways with Natsu.
There you meet Fuyu, who bears an uncanny resemblance to your former lover.
Fuyu is Natsu's older twin brother…
Yet, just like Natsu, he develops romantic feelings for you.
Will you accept his advances?

[From [url=https://jaststore.com/games/galx003/double-black-%E2%85%B1-gentle-sun-in-frost]JAST USA[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了你与黑羽夏分别之后，在一座陌生城市里开启的新生活。
在那里，你邂逅了与昔日恋人容貌惊人相似的黑羽冬。
冬正是夏的双胞胎哥哥……
然而就和夏一样，他也对你渐生情愫。
你会接受他的心意吗？

[摘自[url=https://jaststore.com/games/galx003/double-black-%E2%85%B1-gentle-sun-in-frost]JAST USA[/url]]
